intro: The minus-eighty stood ajar until first light, and the genomics laboratory has not been the same since. Half the aliquots have thawed into ruin; the rest sit in their racks, murmuring in low, competing voices about contamination, missing controls and the postdoc who forgot the alarm. The postdocs in white coats are treating the noise as data, circling the benches with gloves and filling pads with phonetic transcriptions. A brass padlock on the cabinet stays fast until all five signatures are laid on it at once, which is the only reason the manager has not had the whole room emptied. Outside, the corridor lights hum, and nobody has touched the lunchbox someone left by the door.
echo: A small factory, half built from the very kind of message it reads.

puzzles.title: Gel Electrophoresis
hints: Several of these numbers are bigger than 26, so they can't be letter positions. What else has a number that high?

blocks.text: Someone left the minus-eighty open overnight. Half the samples are ruined; the other half have started talking.
